description: On a nonempty individual domain, the unary family containing only the empty relation fails comprehension for \(x=x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.empty_unary_omits_comprehension.{w} {M : Type w} [Nonempty M] :
  ¬∃ R ∈ {fun x => False}, ∀ (b : Fin 1 → M), R b ↔ b 0 = b 0
